# 1331. Rank Transform of an Array

## Solution 1 (time O(nlog(n)), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def arrayRankTransform(self, arr):
        """
        :type arr: List[int]
        :rtype: List[int]
        """
        ranks = {k: v for v, k in enumerate(sorted(set(arr)), 1)}
        return [ranks[v] for v in arr]
```
